rules.name: rrr-report-freshness
rules.sql: SELECT business_unit, cob_date, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, MIN(updated_timestamp) AS first_written, MAX(updated_timestamp) AS last_written, MAX(updated_by) AS last_writer, now() AS database_clock_now FROM opera.rrr_report_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :tenantBu LIMIT 1) AND cob_date IN (:cob, :prevCob) GROUP BY business_unit, cob_date ORDER BY business_unit, cob_date

SELECT business_unit, trim(client_code) AS client_code, mtm, cash_balance, account_status, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM opera.rrr_report_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :tenantBu LIMIT 1) AND cob_date = :cob AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND trim(client_code) IN ('GBS', 'VCI', 'ZUT', 'SCB', 'FEA', 'MDL') ORDER BY client_code
